Subject: Capacity & pricing recap — VertexHealth renewal (volume step-up options)

Hi Arielle and Victor,

Thanks again for the call this morning — appreciated the clear signals on target throughput and the new routing you want to add for the clinical-note summarization model. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we’re aligned: 

Key points from today
- Current committed volume: ~15M tokens/month (embedding + gen).
- VertexHealth is planning two phased step-ups: 1) pilot month spike to 50M tokens; 2) Q3 target steady-state 180–220M tokens/month across two routes (summarization + triage chat).
- Target budget range for renewal: $18k–$28k / month headline (prefers unit economics around $20k for the initial renewal).
- Desired unit target: aiming for ~$8–$12 per 1M tokens blended after step-up (embedding rates weighted higher).
- Required SLO: p95 latency under 400ms for the chat route; embeddings latency less strict.

Questions and clarifications we need from you to finalize a blended quote
1) Expected split by route at steady-state (Q3): what % to summarization vs chat vs embeddings?
2) Any retention/compliance constraints that would require private deployment? (you mentioned a subset of traffic might need VPC).
3) Are there any internal approvals/PO cycles we should time for the renewal signature (finance lead + procurement)?

Proposed next steps
- I’ll share a pricing sketch that shows two blended scenarios: conservative (no volume guarantee) and committed step-up with tiered blended rates. (Ben will run the unit-econ math and provide suggested bands).
- Internal: Ben & Marissa to prepare an SOW draft and a 30-day pilot spike plan we can attach.
- External: Arielle to confirm route split and procurement timing by EOD Wed so we can finalize numbers before end of week.

Attachments: I’ve attached a nominal SOW skeleton and the usage export you sent — Ben, Marissa, please review for any missing items.

Thanks — talk soon.

Best,
Soojin

Thanks Soojin — great summary. A few quick clarifications: 

1) Route split (expected at Q3 steady-state):
- Summarization (clinical notes): ~60%
- Chat (patient triage assistant): ~30%
- Embeddings (search + similarity): ~10%

2) Compliance: majority of traffic is fine on hosted, but the clinical notes route will need VPC enclaves for PHI-derived content. That means the summarization route should be priced as "private option" if we need dedicated capacity.

3) Procurement timeline: we need a PO by 2027-04-15; budget owners are confirming the $/month band this week. If we can get a committed step-up pricing that floors at 150M tokens/month for the Q3 term, that’s what they’ll target.

On unit economics: we are hoping to land in the $9–$11 / 1M blended range if we commit to the 150M floor. If that’s not feasible we’ll consider a short pilot spike to 50M then re-evaluate.

Happy to hop on a quick call tomorrow if it helps.

—Arielle
VP Product, VertexHealth

Subject: Internal: proposed blended math for VertexHealth (draft)

Soojin / Marissa — draft math below for the 150M committed floor scenario Arielle asked for. Assumptions: current hosted baseline rates (gen: $12 / 1M, embeddings: $20 / 1M), dedicated/private add-on +20% premium on summarization route when VPC required, blended calc weighted by route split Arielle provided.

Baseline numbers
- Summarization (60% of 150M = 90M tokens): base hosted equivalent cost at $12/1M = $1,080 -> private add-on +20% = $1,296 (per 90M chunk scaled).
- Chat (30% = 45M): $12/1M -> $540
- Embeddings (10% = 15M): $20/1M -> $300

Total monthly token cost (raw): $1,296 + $540 + $300 = $2,136 (this is the provider cost-equivalent; Redwood headline will include platform/ops margin + committed discount).

To hit VertexHealth target blended $/1M of $10 across 150M -> headline target monthly invoice = $1,500. That implies Redwood would need to offer sizable blended discounts vs baseline — ~30% effective off the baseline math. Options:
A) Committed volume + 12‑month term at 150M floor -> we can offer $10 / 1M blended (monthly = $1,500) by structuring per-route pricing with a private-premium credit and a usage true-up.
B) Pilot spike then reprice -> start with 50M pilot (no deep discount), then transition to tiered blended pricing if step-up to >=150M within 60 days.

Internal asks
- Marissa: please draft SOW with clause for VPC summarization route and an initial 30‑day pilot that allows a smooth spike to 50M.
- Soojin: confirm if Vertex wants a single invoice for blended or separate lines for private add-on. Arielle’s team prefers single blended line for ease.

I’ll prepare a one-slide unit-econ summary to include with the external note.

—Ben
Account Pricing Lead, Redwood Inference
